title: Scientists find a youth protein that helps aging brain cells act young again
caption:
A protein linked to youth might hold the key to keeping our brain's immune system working longer. New research shows that restoring this protein in older mice helped their brain cells clear debris more effectively.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists find a youth protein that helps aging brain cells act young again

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261016070646.htm
